skill_name: Summarize the differences between qualitative and quantitative data.
workflow: Qualitative and quantitative data are two distinct types of data that can be used to answer different types of questions. Qualitative data involves descriptive information that is often subjective and is used to answer questions such as “why?” and “how?”. This data usually comes in the form of interviews, text, images and audio.
